name: Can I replace interior doors with different sizes or types than the originals?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace interior doors with different sizes or types than the originals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can replace interior doors with different sizes or types than the originals, but it may require additional work. Changing the door type, such as switching from a standard hinged door to a barn door, will necessitate frame modifications or new wall reinforcement. If you're altering the door's height or width, adjustments to the existing door frame opening will be required, which can involve carpentry work and potentially drywall repair. This may affect the project timeline and cost. We assess existing openings and discuss necessary modifications to ensure structural integrity and a seamless finish, providing tailored solutions for your vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but changing door sizes or types often requires frame modifications, carpentry, and potential drywall work, impacting project timeline and cost.
